findings.title: Restrike: under column-0 agreement, column -1 defects equal column 1 defects masked by white column-0 cells
findings.claim: If c0(t)=c0(t+P) and c0(t+1)=c0(t+1+P) then D(t,-1)=D(t,1) AND NOT c0(t), D=A XOR A shifted by P. With the adjacent-pair joint-periodicity lemma, an eventually P-periodic column 0 forces infinitely many t>=T with c0(t)=0 and c1(t)!=c1(t+P).
findings.scope: Exact seed, physical frame. Identity is elementary algebra; consequence uses r30-photograde-20261025T122841Z-abce3ea0-v01 F003 applied to pair (-1,0). Not kernel checked.
findings.result: Paper proof in REPORT.md. Identity verified on the seed for P<=512, t<4707: 570026 premise instances, 0 mismatches.
limitations: Modest: a necessary condition on a counterexample, not an exclusion.
findings.next_action: Iterate the masked identity leftward to express D(.,-k) via D(.,1) and periodic column 0; formalize F001+F003 in Lean.

findings.title: Restrike: near-restrikes of the seed are generic and never rim-witnessed at finite scale
findings.claim: Finite joint (columns 0,1) agreement runs between the seed diagram and its P-shift are distinguished from generic orbits, or are ended by the light-cone rim.
findings.scope: P<=512, T<4096; certificates for the 2000 longest runs; control: 5 random-row orbits on a periodic ring, seeds 20261025-20261029.
findings.result: Seed max run 17, mean 1.612; controls max 15-18, mean 1.594-1.608. Certificate L<=L*-1 held in all cases (tight in 22/25 top runs); 0/2000 rim-witnessed.
limitations: Controls have no light cone, so rim classification is not comparable there; only run statistics are.
findings.next_action: Stop the statistics; any rim argument is purely asymptotic.
